newsitem.title: UK: Europay, Mastercard sign new debit alliance. [CORRECTED 12:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Europay, Mastercard sign new debit alliance. [CORRECTED 12:55 GMT]

text.p: European payment system Europay International and global payments system MasterCard International have signed a new debit alliance agreement designed to foster greater cross-border debit card usage.
The agreement means that automatic teller machine and point of sale functions will be brought together under one brand -- Maestro.
Europay/Mastercard said in a statement it had 82 per cent of the European debit card market.
It said that as a result of the deal, 60 million German eurocheque and bank proprietary cards will migrate to Maestro.
The deal also clears the way for British banks to accept Maestro cards in the UK. (Corrects to clarify position of British banks).
